name: io.github.techaurah/leadpipe-mcp
description: An MCP server that gives AI assistants a safe lead pipeline (dedup, scoring, stages, booking) over a Google Sheet, for small businesses with no CRM.

environmentVariables.name: LEADPIPE_DEMO
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for the zero-credential demo mode with seeded data.

environmentVariables.name: LEADPIPE_SHEET_ID
environmentVariables.description: Google Sheet ID holding the pipeline; required outside demo mode.

environmentVariables.name: LEADPIPE_CALENDAR_ID
environmentVariables.description: Calendar to check and book against; use primary or a calendar ID.

environmentVariables.name: LEADPIPE_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Write safety mode: direct, dry_run, or approval.
